name: KO_SOCIALI
description:
This repository contains the data presented in BenchHub: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Holistic and Customizable LLM Evaluation.
BenchHub is a unified benchmark suite designed to help researchers and developers easily load, filter, and process various LLM benchmark datasets. It enables efficient dataset handling for training and evaluation, providing flexible filtering capabilities.
Project page: https://huggingface.co/BenchHub
Code: https://github.com/rladmstn1714/BenchHub
reputation: Distributed as part of the BenchHub collection; benefits from the BenchHub tooling and visibility but individual dataset adoption varies and is primarily within research groups using BenchHub.
